item.title: Doha hosts second WSJ Tech: Qatar conference from Sunday
item.description:
Doha will host the second edition of WSJ Tech: Qatar from 30 November to 2 December, bringing together technology executives, investors and founders from around the world and the region. The invitation-only conference stems from a partnership between the Government Communications Office and Dow Jones, publisher of The Wall Street Journal. GCO Director Sheikh Jassim bin Mansour bin Jabor Al Thani said Qatar is the only country outside the United States to host the paper's flagship technology event.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266641/latest-news/doha-to-host-second-edition-of-wsj-tech-qatar-from-nov-30 · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739081/qatar/qatar-to-roll-out-red-carpet-for-techs-biggest-names

item.title: «Takamul» initiative gives 2,426 tablets to private school students
item.description:
The Ministry of Education and Higher Education and Qatar Charity launched the «Takamul for Sustainable Education» initiative to support eligible students from low-income families in private schools. Minister Lolwah bint Rashid Al Khater said the initiative provides 2,426 tablets, along with school supplies and workshops on communication and leadership skills. Qatar Charity CEO Yousef bin Ahmed Al Kuwari attended the launch.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/ministry-of-education-and-higher-education-qatar-charity-launch-sustainable-education-initiative · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/27/11/2026/لولوة-الخاطر-2426-جهازا-لوحيا-للطلبة-المستحقين-في-المدارس-الخاصة

item.title: Lusail opens pit lane to fans and adds sensory spaces
item.description:
Lusail International Circuit opened its pit lane to fans on Thursday evening ahead of the Formula 1 Qatar Grand Prix, letting them see garages and cars up close and take photos with drivers. The circuit set up a sensory space in the Fan Zone and a room overlooking the track in the commentary building for people with sensory sensitivities, in cooperation with the Shafallah Center and the Qatar Autism Society.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/lusail-circuit-launches-sensory-initiatives-ahead-of-qatar-grand-prix · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739076/sport/formula-1/lusail-international-circuit-hosts-pit-lane-walks-and-inclusion-initiatives-ahead-qatar-grand-prix

item.title: Verstappen enters Qatar GP 37 points clear in runner-up fight
item.description:
The Formula 1 Qatar Grand Prix gets under way today, Friday, at Lusail, before the season finale in Abu Dhabi. Mercedes have secured both titles, with Italian Kimi Antonelli becoming the youngest world champion. Max Verstappen leads Lewis Hamilton by 37 points in the fight for second place, while George Russell and Lando Norris are level on 264 points.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/26/11/2026/qatar-gp-set-to-fuel-f1s-season-long-rivalries · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266705/sports/verstappen-remains-the-man-to-beat-at-f1-qatar-gp

item.title: Qatar basketball team loses 52-74 to South Korea
item.description:
Qatar's basketball team lost 52-74 to South Korea on Thursday evening at Al Janoub, in the second round of the Asian qualifiers for the 2027 World Cup. The game marked the debut of Tunisian coach Hatem Mamlouk, who replaced Turkey's Hakan Demir, and Mike Lewis led Qatar with 24 points. Qatar are using the qualifiers as preparation, having secured a finals place as hosts.
Sources: Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/27/11/2026/خسارة-قطر-أمام-كوريا-الجنوبية-في-تصفيات-آسيا-المؤهلة-لكأس-العالم-لكرة-السلة-2027 · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739080/sport/basketball/qatar-outclassed-by-south-korea-in-world-cup-qualifiers

item.title: Justice minister: sound legislation is society's first line of defence
item.description:
Minister of Justice and Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs Ibrahim bin Ali Al Mohannadi said on Thursday that sound legislation is society's first line of defence, and that the Permanent Constitution links the rule of law with the guarantee of security and stability. He was speaking to the third cohort of the Security Leadership and Staff Program at the Police Academy, in a session on the legislative system's role in supporting security work.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/26/11/2026/minister-of-justice-outlines-legislative-framework-supporting-security-work · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739090/qatar/sound-legislation-serves-as-first-line-of-defence-for-society

item.title: Coalition destroys 50 Houthi targets and a Hodeidah missile launcher
item.description:
Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki Al Maliki said late on Thursday that coalition forces destroyed 50 Houthi military targets in Sanaa, Hodeidah and Saada governorates. He said the coalition destroyed in Hodeidah the ballistic missile launcher used in the attack on the Jazan refinery. Al Maliki had warned that targeting civilians and civilian facilities would be met with a firm military response.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666569/saudi-arabia/coalition-destroys-50-houthi-military-targets-and-ballistic-missile-launcher-in-yemen · Al Sharq (QNA, citing SPA) https://al-sharq.com/article/26/11/2026/التحالف-يعلن-تنفيذ-عملية-عسكرية-لاستهداف-قدرات-جماعة-الحوثي · Gulf News (live) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-saudi-refinery-attack-kills-worker-iran-denies-deadly-kuwait-strike-1.500761343

item.title: Kuwait asserts right to self-defence as Iran denies attack
item.description:
Kuwait's Foreign Ministry affirmed the country's right to take all necessary measures to protect its sovereignty and vital facilities under Article 51 of the UN Charter, after a drone attack on Thursday killed two Italians and injured a Kuwaiti and a Pakistani. Iranian armed forces spokesman Abolfazl Shekarchi denied any operation in the region. Rome confirmed the two dead were technicians with Rheinmetall Italia.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/kuwait-condemns-continued-iranian-attacks-affirms-right-to-self-defense · Kuwait Times https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54460/kuwait/barbaric-assault/ · Arab Times https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/kuwait-condemns-iranian-drone-attack-reserves-right-to-self-defense/ · Gulf News (live) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-saudi-refinery-attack-kills-worker-iran-denies-deadly-kuwait-strike-1.500761343

item.title: Dubai opens the Gulf's first pumped-storage hydroelectric plant
item.description:
Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum on Thursday opened in Hatta the Dubai Electricity and Water Authority's Dh1.4 billion hydroelectric plant, the first of its kind in the GCC. The 250MW plant uses solar power to pump water uphill and generates electricity as it flows back down. He also reviewed projects under the Hatta 2040 plan, which targets an economic impact of about Dh1.2 billion.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/government/sheikh-mohammed-reviews-dh12-billion-hatta-plan-opens-dh14-billion-power-plant-1.500762219 · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/26/sheikh-mohammed-opens-dh14-billion-hydroelectric-plant-during-hatta-visit/

item.title: Oman and Japan discuss green hydrogen and advanced industry ties
item.description:
Omani Foreign Minister Sayyid Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi met Japan's Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry Ryosei Akazawa in Tokyo on Thursday to discuss expanding trade and joint investment. The talks focused on green hydrogen and ammonia, advanced manufacturing, technology, logistics and food security. The meeting is part of a two-day official visit to Japan that ends today, Friday.
Sources: Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200284/world/oman-japan-eye-expanded-ties-in-green-hydrogen-and-tech · Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179632-oman-japan-discuss-expanding-economic-and-investment-ties

item.title: Kuwait permanently closes Al Rai bird and pet market
item.description:
Kuwait's Public Authority for Agricultural Affairs and Fish Resources ordered the permanent closure of the bird and pet market in Al Rai from 1 December, citing public health and safety. Administrative Decision No. 970 of 2026 requires shop owners to vacate and hand over their premises, cleared, to the animal health department within two months, while the finance ministry will terminate existing licences.
Sources: Kuwait Times https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54461/kuwait/pet-market-in-rai-permanently-shut/ · Arab Times https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/kuwait-orders-permanent-closure-of-al-rai-bird-market-from-december-1/

item.title: Gold rises EGP80 as 21-carat reaches EGP5,630
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt rose by about EGP80 on Friday morning, with the most traded 21-carat at about EGP5,630, as the ounce climbed globally to around $3,580. 24-carat ranged between EGP6,434 and EGP6,451 for buying depending on the source, and the gold pound stood at EGP45,040. Sada El Balad said the weekly rise averaged no more than EGP70.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/27/أسعار-الذهب-اليوم-الجمعة-27-نوفمبر-2026-عيار-21-يسجل/7633661 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7196037 · Veto https://www.vetogate.com/5779037 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/27/الجنيه-الذهب-اليوم-الجمعة-في-مصر-عند-45040-جنيهًا/7633743

item.title: New donations for Warraq victims from Zakat House and Libyan foundation
item.description:
The Zakat and Charity House, on the instructions of Al-Azhar's Grand Imam Ahmed El-Tayeb, allocated EGP10 million in urgent support for the families of those killed and injured in the Ring Road fire in Warraq. Libya's Khalifa International Foundation for Humanitarian Work pledged the equivalent of EGP25 million for families and the injured, in coordination with Egyptian authorities. Donations continue after exceeding EGP200 million in seven hours.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/26/بيت-الزكاة-والصدقات-يخصص-10-ملايين-جنيه-دعما-لأسر-شهداء/7633853 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536601 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/26/ردًا-لجميل-مصر-مؤسسة-خليفة-الليبية-تتبرع-بـ25-مليون-لدعم/7633899 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536672

item.title: Awqaf dedicates Friday sermon to solidarity and opens 22 mosques
item.description:
The Ministry of Awqaf, on a decision by Minister Osama Al-Azhari, changed today's Friday sermon to «solidarity and consolation in hardship, and unity in times of crisis», in light of the Warraq Ring Road disaster. The ministry is also opening 22 mosques today: 3 new, 11 rebuilt and 8 renovated. That brings the number of mosques opened since July 2026 to 433.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/27/3085215/موضوع-خطبة-الجمعة-بعد-تغييرها-تضامن-ا-مع-ضحايا-حادث-دائري-الوراق · Egypt Telegraph https://www.egypttelegraph.com/article/299562/خطبة-الجمعة-غدًا-27-نوفمبر-2026-pdf · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/27/3085217/الأوقاف-تفتتح-22-مسجد-ا-اليوم-في-13-محافظة · Veto https://www.vetogate.com/5778985

item.title: Port Said Film Festival postponed to June 2027 in solidarity
item.description:
The Port Said Film Festival, headed by critic Ahmed Asar, announced it was postponing its second edition to June 2027 in view of the national mourning after the petroleum tanker fire in Warraq. The organisers said in a statement that the decision followed consultations and was made in solidarity with the families of the victims and the injured, and that they would notify the relevant authorities of the new date.
Sources: Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7196175 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536661

item.title: Egypt and Germany discuss easing study and medical visas
item.description:
Egypt and Germany held a round of consular consultations at the Foreign Ministry in Cairo, chaired by Assistant Foreign Minister for Consular Affairs Ambassador Haddad Abdel Tawab El-Gohary and German Deputy Director for Legal and Consular Affairs Christian Klein. The agenda was led by easing study and medical visas for Egyptians, skilled labour mobility and judicial cooperation, with representatives of the labour, tourism, health and justice ministries.
Sources: Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=27112026&id=acd7bbc9-bfc2-4844-b596-18b47947535a · National Media Authority (Maspero) https://www.maspero.eg/egypt/2026/11/27/1009153/انعقاد-جولة-المشاورات-القنصلية-بين-مصر-وألمانيا

item.title: Egypt and Denmark prepare roadmap for a competitive power market
item.description:
Electricity Minister Mahmoud Esmat on Thursday chaired the fifth steering committee meeting of the Egyptian-Danish strategic energy cooperation programme, attended by Danish Ambassador Lars Bo Moller. Esmat said Denmark is supporting a roadmap for the electricity market that sets the roles of operators and regulators and paves the way for competitive markets and cross-border power trade. The meeting also covered wind power and local manufacturing of its components.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/26/وزير-الكهرباء-يترأس-اجتماع-اللجنة-التوجيهية-المصرية-الدانمركية-للتعاون/7633357 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7196064

item.title: EU summit ends without deal on 2028-2034 budget
item.description:
An extraordinary EU summit in Brussels ended late on Thursday without agreement on the bloc's 2028-2034 budget, as leaders clung to their red lines. European Council President António Costa's €1.78 trillion proposal failed to win support, with seven countries seeking cuts and 17 rejecting further reductions. Costa said the EU needs a new budget by 1 January 2028.
Sources: Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/27/a-lot-of-political-theatre-eu-summit-ends-in-disarray-as-leaders-cling-to-red-lines · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/26/eu-leaders-struggle-to-agree-on-long-term-budget-more-money-for-ukraine

item.title: Thanksgiving storms cut power to 900,000 US customers
item.description:
Storms and heavy rain hit the eastern United States and the Midwest on Thursday, leaving more than 900,000 homes and businesses without power, according to PowerOutage.us. More than 2,000 flights were delayed and over 400 cancelled, according to FlightAware. Macy's postponed its Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York until Saturday.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/americas/us-thanksgiving-storms-heavy-rain-floods-and-power-cuts-hit-states-1.500762601 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7196205

item.title: Argentina enters technical recession after 1.8% third-quarter contraction
item.description:
Argentina's economy entered a technical recession after contracting 1.8% in the third quarter of 2026, following a 1% fall in the second quarter, according to the statistics institute's monthly activity estimator. Activity grew 1.1% in September from August, driven by oil and mining. Economy Minister Luis Caputo played down the recession, calling its definition «almost arbitrary».
Sources: Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/26/argentina-enters-technical-recession-as-weak-consumption-undermines-mileis-economic-gains · Buenos Aires Herald https://buenosairesherald.com/economics/caputo-downplays-argentinas-technical-recession

item.title: Guinea-Bissau junta delays elections to November 2028
item.description:
Guinea-Bissau's transitional president, Maj. Gen. Horta Inta-a, postponed the presidential and legislative elections due on 6 December to 26 November 2028 by a decree issued on Thursday. The decree cited a lack of technical, material and financial conditions to hold the vote. The army seized power a year ago, overthrowing President Umaro Sissoco Embalo.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/guinea-bissau-presidential-election-delayed-by-two-years · Xinhua https://english.news.cn/20261127/a18513c43d1c47b6aaa79c3e5ad63046/c.html · TRT Afrika https://trtafrika.com/english/article/2713d83a257b

item.title: Explosion at Bangchak refinery in Bangkok injures nine
item.description:
Nine people, some in critical condition, were injured in an explosion at Bangchak Corporation's refinery in Bangkok's Phra Khanong district on Thursday afternoon, according to Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt. The company said the fire was put out within 30 minutes and all production units were shut pending safety checks. The cause is not yet known.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666560/world/nine-people-injured-in-explosion-at-bangkok-oil-refinery · Free Malaysia Today (AFP) https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2026/11/26/nine-hurt-in-huge-explosion-at-bangkok-oil-facility

item.title: Tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel sinks off Ibiza
item.description:
The Maltese-flagged tanker Med Emre, carrying about 7,000 tonnes of diesel, sank early on Thursday roughly 25 nautical miles off the Spanish island of Ibiza, and one sailor died. The other 16 crew members survived, and Balearic authorities activated a civil protection plan over the risk of a fuel spill, with the maritime rescue service sending a boat and a plane to assess damage.
Sources: Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/26/ship-transporting-7000-tonnes-of-diesel-sinks-off-ibiza-one-crewman-dead · Free Malaysia Today (AFP) https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2026/11/26/ship-carrying-diesel-sinks-off-spain-s-ibiza-one-dead-rescuers
